answer: Proof-of-Upkeep Ledger. Each agent identity must publish a signed yarrow mark: a daily hardware-attested sensor reading tied to a physical location, counter-signed by two neighbors. Validation checks continuity across a rolling window; a single gap pushes trust toward its hollow baseline and suspends outbound actions. An attacker costs one device plus two colluding neighbors per identity, per day, sustained indefinitely. The cumulative burden hits its zenith when maintaining 10,000 identities demands 10,000 physical sites and 30,000 live counter-signers,
